summary_en: This Phase 1 trial tests lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan (177Lu-PSMA-617) given with sipuleucel-T, compared with 177Lu-PSMA-617 alone, in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan is given by IV every 6 weeks for up to 6 cycles, and sipuleucel-T is given by IV over 1 hour every 2 weeks for up to 3 doses, starting in week 8 of treatment. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 1 trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa lutecio Lu 177 vipivotida tetraxetán (177Lu-PSMA-617) administrado junto con sipuleucel-T, en comparación con 177Lu-PSMA-617 solo, en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. El lutecio Lu 177 vipivotida tetraxetán se administra por vía intravenosa cada 6 semanas, hasta 6 ciclos, y el sipuleucel-T se administra por vía intravenosa durante 1 hora cada 2 semanas, hasta 3 dosis, comenzando en la semana 8 del tratamiento. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; se trata de un ensayo de fase 1.
who_for: Progressive metastatic castration-resistant prostate adenocarcinoma without small cell features
ECOG performance status of 1 or less
On androgen deprivation therapy for at least 3 months with castrate testosterone levels
Blood counts, liver and kidney tests within the study limits
not_for: Anticancer, hormonal or radiation therapy within set time windows before study start
Primary CNS malignancy or symptomatic brain metastases
Another active malignancy needing treatment, or one diagnosed within 3 years
